text: Open the wooden puzzle box on the counter, take out the tomato inside, and stand it inside the tray. The lid slides sideways but is locked by sliding bolts with round black handles: a part moves only when nothing blocks it, so work out the order. Any order that works is fine. Once the tomato is inside the tray and you have let go of everything, press the red SUBMIT button. Your first submission ends the episode; a wrong submission or no submission fails. You act through helper actions; the helpers move objects exactly. Instead of pressing Submit, give your answer with SUBMIT.
intro: On the counter stands a wooden box with a sliding lid and 6 sliders (metal bars with round handles), numbered 1 to 6 by their handles from left to right as the left camera sees them. A tray and a red SUBMIT button stand on the counter beside it. The tip of slider 1 rests in a notch in the side of slider 4. The tip of slider 2 rests in a notch in the side of slider 1. The tip of slider 3 rests in a notch in the side of slider 5. The tip of slider 4 rests in a notch in the side of slider 3. The tip of slider 5 rests in a notch in the side of slider 6. The tip of slider 6 rests in a notch in the edge of the lid. The tomato is inside the closed box.
help:
PULL SLIDER n - pull slider n out by its handle as far as it goes (a part moves only when nothing blocks it)
PUSH SLIDER n - push slider n in, away from its handle, as far as it goes
OPEN THE LID - slide the lid open (it moves only when nothing blocks it)
SUBMIT a b ... - your answer: pull the named sliders in this order (name none if nothing more must move), then slide the lid open; if it opens, stand the tomato in the tray, let go and press Submit
